## Part 4 - Tuning the tree depth

In part 4 the code performs a cross-validation experiment to tune the tree depth parameter.

4.1 How many folds are used in the cross-validation procedure? How can you tell from the code?

------------------------------------------------------------------------


The table produced reports the mean accuracy for each value of the tree depth. The accuracy is defined as:
$$
\text{Accuracy} = \frac{\text{Number of correct predictions}}{\text{Total numnef of predictions}}
$$

4.2 Why does the output report the "Mean CV Accuracy" rather than a single accuracy value? What does the reported standard deviation tell us?

------------------------------------------------------------------------


4.3 Does performance improve indefinitely as depth increases? Why might very deep trees perform worse than shallow tree? Which depth value would you choose?

------------------------------------------------------------------------
